column2: [saint_person.GetTitledName] is dead, and the skalds and the elders are already arguing over [saint_person.GetHerHis] memory. Some say [saint_person.GetSheHe] should be raised among the honoured dead of our faith, a name to be called on before battle and at every feast, an ancestor for all our people and not only [saint_person.GetHerHis] own house.\n\nThe decision is mine.

[From.GetTitledName] has raised [saint_person.GetTitledName] among the honoured ancestors of the [saint_person.Religion.GetName] faith. [saint_person.GetHerHisCap] name will be called on before battle and spoken at every feast, and the faithful will leave offerings at [saint_person.GetHerHis] grave for generations.\n\nThe blood of [saint_person.GetDynName] is held sacred from this day.
[saint_person.GetTitledName] will be made an §YHonoured Ancestor§! of the faith. [saint_person.GetHerHisCap] §YDynasty§! would surely appreciate the gesture.
[saint_person.GetSheHeCap] was raised among the honoured ancestors of [saint_person.GetHerHis] faith, a name called on before battle and at every feast.
